concept.title: The Suns of Selcalsar
concept.logline: On sunlit, melancholy Selcalsar, you scour every corner to recover the sun shards and restore the Great Obelisk.
concept.source_prompt: Oasis Flats. oasis bazaar mirage flats adventure The hunt
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Oasis Market and becomes the one who brings the Great Obelisk back to life.

key_locations.name: Oasis Market
key_locations.description: The start: palms and awnings around a spring.

key_locations.name: Dry Wharf
key_locations.description: Dry Wharf: a dock on the way out from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Date Palm Oasis
key_locations.description: Date Palm Oasis: a grove on the way out from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Scorpion Grotto
key_locations.description: Scorpion Grotto: a cave of Selcalsar, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Great Obelisk
key_locations.description: Great Obelisk: a landmark of Selcalsar, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

characters.name: Caravan Master Bram
characters.description: Waits in Oasis Market and knows why the Great Obelisk fell silent.

characters.name: Kai the Guide
characters.description: Follows you from Oasis Market and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Dune Stalker
characters.description: A dune stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Dune Stalker 2
characters.description: A dune stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Dust Mite
characters.description: One of a pack of dust mites: weak alone, dangerous together.

characters.description: One of a pack of dust mites: weak alone, dangerous together.

characters.name: Piet the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Selcalsar for anything shiny.

hazards: Dune Stalker hunting near its lair

actions.value: On sunlit, melancholy Selcalsar, you scour every corner to recover the sun shards and restore the Great Obelisk.
4 hostiles roam The Suns of Selcalsar. Close in and strike with E.
The land is safe again. The bounty is yours.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Bram
nodes.text: So you've come to Oasis Market at last. I am Caravan Master Bram. On sunlit, melancholy Selcalsar, you scour every corner to recover the sun shards and restore the Great Obelisk.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Bram
nodes.text: Back again. Oasis Market is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Bram
nodes.text: Go to Dry Wharf, then Date Palm Oasis. Whatever still remembers The Suns of Selcalsar is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Bram
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Oasis Market, The Suns of Selcalsar was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Peaceful, even then.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Bram
nodes.text: Dry Wharf: Dry Wharf: a dock on the way out from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Bram
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of The Suns of Selcalsar back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Bram
nodes.text: Date Palm Oasis: Date Palm Oasis: a grove on the way out from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Guide
nodes.text: Kai the Guide circles your feet, then looks toward Great Obelisk as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Guide
nodes.text: Kai the Guide hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Guide
nodes.text: It turns toward Great Obelisk. Great Obelisk: a landmark of Selcalsar, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Dune Stalker
nodes.text: The dune stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Dune Stalker 2
nodes.text: The dune stalker 2 watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Oasis Market. Piet the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of The Suns of Selcalsar that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Dry Wharf after dark. I don't go there myself.
